_what: Battle-mode team A (E-BM, for the Lv 50 rule: BM1-BM3; playthrough-guide.md Appendix D 'Every Battle Mode menu option once'). Applied to a COPY of a story save on the separate battle-mode card, never snatcherLeo's story card. Six Pokemon at Lv 50, every held item different (the registration rules, verified by D), all moves from each species' level-up or TM/HM lists on the disc. Themes: weather on entry and the weather fight (Kyogre's Drizzle vs Groudon's Drought), Intimidate on entry, two-turn moves (Fly, Dig, Solar Beam), multi-turn Thrash, a recharge move (Hyper Beam), Spikes, status over turns (Toxic, Leech Seed, Sleep Powder), moves that hit both foes or everyone (Surf, Earthquake), multi-hit Bullet Seed, and held items with no story source (Sitrus, Lum, Starf, Persim berries, Choice Band, Shell Bell). Kyogre and Groudon at Lv 50: caught at Lv 45 in the GBA games, so legal (likely).

add_pokemon._note: Kyogre (Drizzle), Modest: Surf, Ice Beam, Thunder (sure-hit in rain), Calm Mind; Sitrus Berry
Groudon (Drought), Adamant: Earthquake, Solar Beam (one turn in sun), Fire Blast, Dig (two-turn); Lum Berry
Gyarados (Intimidate), Adamant: Thrash (multi-turn), Dragon Dance (Lv 50), Earthquake (hits the partner too), Hyper Beam (recharge); Choice Band
Skarmory (Keen Eye), Adamant: Spikes (Lv 42), Fly (two-turn, HM02), Toxic, Protect; Shell Bell
Venusaur (Overgrow), Modest: Solar Beam (two-turn without sun), Leech Seed, Sleep Powder, Giga Drain; Starf Berry
Ludicolo (Swift Swim), Modest: Rain Dance, Bullet Seed (multi-hit), Ice Beam, Protect; Persim Berry
